prompt: You have $\$9$ saved and add $\$4.50$ to your jar every week. Solve $4.5w + 9 = 36$ to find how many weeks until you reach $\$36$. Give just the number.
hint: Subtract the $\$9$ head start from both sides first.

hints.text: Subtract the $\$9$ head start from both sides first.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try round numbers: if you added $\$9$ a week you would need $27 \div 9 = 3$ weeks. Same recipe here, just divide by $4.5$ instead.

alternativeExplanations.title: Think in half-dollars
steps: $\$4.50$ a week is 9 half-dollars a week, and you need $\$27$ more, which is 54 half-dollars.
$54 \div 9 = 6$ weeks — same answer, no decimals needed.
